Finding: Survival blocks for two different experiments (rgH5N1 challenge on day 14 vs day 3 after vaccination) are identical cell-for-cell (28 rows x 4 groups, including every death day).
Evidence / method: Whole-block identity test (dupscan). The matching body-weight blocks differ: S15-D implies 2/7 deaths with PSLN-344 (cols W, AC: weights frozen at 79.5 and 85.2 from day 8) and 2/7 with young PSLN-212 (cols F, G), whereas S06-D records 0/7 for both.
Impact on conclusions: Day-3 rgH5N1 protection claim for PSLN-344 is unsupported; true S06-D outcome unknown.
Handling in this analysis: S06-D excluded from all pooled analyses (sets B-D); shown greyed in Fig 1.
Resolution required: Retrieve the day-3 rgH5N1 survival record (clinical score sheets / death log).

Finding: Alveolar-macrophage (S11-A) and neutrophil (S11-B) blocks share identical values at 35/100 matched positions, concentrated in replicate columns 1-2 of every group and day.
Evidence / method: Within group x day permutation null: mean 8.2, max 19 identical positions in 5,000 shuffles (posdup; T15). Annotation states the two came from differently harvested lungs.
Impact on conclusions: Neither AM nor neutrophil kinetics can be interpreted; neutrophil data cannot be used as a tolerability readout.
Resolution required: Re-export both populations from the original FCS files/gating templates.

Blocks / cells: Body-weight blocks S08-D, S09-E, S15-A, S15-C, S15-E, S15-F, S15-J, S15-K, S15-M, S15-O
Finding: High-precision weight ratios recur across different animals in different experiments. 68 distinct 6-digit fractional parts are shared by >=2 animals (T14). Some series are verbatim copies (S09-E col X [young BALB/c, PSLN-344, Perth H3N2] = S15-M col I [C57BL/6, young PSLN-212] on days 2, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14; day 4 differs only in the integer digit, 98.98780488 vs 92.98780488); others share decimals with altered integer parts (95.87912088 / 98.87912088 / 97.87912088 / 94.87912088 in S15-A, S15-J, S15-K, S15-M).
Evidence / method: Two independent animals cannot share an 8-10-significant-digit weight ratio by chance; the pattern is consistent with copy-and-edit of template series (bwforensic; T14; Fig 6b).
Impact on conclusions: Body-weight data cannot be used as efficacy or tolerability evidence; casts doubt on the provenance of the linked survival records.
Handling in this analysis: Body weight used only as a cross-check of survival counts (A4), never as an endpoint.
Resolution required: For-cause audit against raw balance printouts / animal-room records; interview data originators.

Finding: Deaths implied by the body-weight records disagree with the survival records in 10 group-level comparisons (T13). Largest: S03-I PSLN-212 records 7/7 deaths by day 6, but S13-F (stated to be the same animals) shows all 7 alive at day 8 and 3 recovering to 95-99% by day 14.
Evidence / method: Concordance algorithm: death = trailing blanks, or trailing run of >=3 identical weights (or >=2 below 90%) (concord; T13).
Impact on conclusions: Survival counts in affected experiments are uncertain by 1-3 animals per group.
Handling in this analysis: Sensitivity analysis C uses the count less favourable to PSLN-344 / more favourable to PSLN-212; analysis D restricts to concordant experiments (T3).

Finding: Body-weight blocks annotated as "the animals of S03-I / S03-J" contain a Naive group absent from those survival blocks and lack CMP-204 (S13-F) and PSLN-212 (S13-G). S13-G "Naive" (9 deaths incl. 2 by day 4, 1 survivor) matches S03-J "Sham" (9 deaths incl. days 3 and 4, 1 survivor), suggesting shifted labels.
Evidence / method: Group lists compared with annotation; death timing compared (showbw).
Impact on conclusions: S13-F/G cannot corroborate S03-I/J; group labels in one or both sheets are unreliable.

Finding: IgG2a:IgG1 columns are rotated relative to the raw subclass titres: printed "PSLN-212" = raw young PSLN-212; printed "PSLN-344" = raw PSLN-212; printed "PSLN-212(Y)" = raw PSLN-344.
Evidence / method: Per-animal ratios recomputed from S13-A/S13-B and S13-C/S13-D match the printed columns only after rotation (reuse).
Impact on conclusions: As printed, PSLN-344 appears Th2-skewed (ratio 0.58); corrected it is Th1-skewed (1.85 vs 0.55 for PSLN-212).
Handling in this analysis: Corrected labels used (T4); S13 raw titres treated as authoritative because their ranking matches total IgG (S03-A).

Evidence / method: Its Ifnb1 row equals log10 of S01-A 72-h values (13/21 exact; group means within 0.01 log10 of S01-A 72 h vs 0.89 log10 from 16 h) (T5).
Impact on conclusions: Reading it as 16 h would understate 16-h inflammation and mis-time cytokine kinetics.
Handling in this analysis: Treated as 72 h; only block 1 used for 16-h cytokines (T6).

Finding: Dead animals recorded inconsistently: blank cells (most Sham groups) vs last weight carried forward (most PSLN groups), sometimes within one block (e.g., S15-E).
Evidence / method: Trailing identical values for 3-6 consecutive weighings.
Impact on conclusions: Any group-mean weight curve that includes carried-forward values is biased upward for groups with deaths.
Handling in this analysis: Body weight not used as an endpoint.
Resolution required: Define dead-animal handling in the SOP; re-derive curves.

Finding: Stated n differs from observations: S03-J stated 9, observed 10/group, and one PSLN-344 animal has no day value (S03!G46; event 0); observation stated as 22 d but censoring at 21 d. S13-E stated 5, observed 7/group. S09-F Sham observed 7 (stated 8). The annotation swaps the S09-B and S09-F Sham counts. S05-A/B stated 3, observed 2.
Impact on conclusions: Raises the possibility of post-hoc inclusion or exclusion of animals.
Handling in this analysis: Observed data analysed as recorded; S03-J missing day set to 21 (censored); S03-J removed in sensitivity set C.
Resolution required: Explain every discrepancy from the raw records.

Finding: NP366-374 tetramer staining reported in default BALB/c (H-2d) mice, although NP366-374 is an H-2Db-restricted (C57BL/6) epitope. Conditions are contradictory (ovalbumin immunisation vs bivalent vaccine), and only n=2 per timepoint. S05-I is described as "vaccinated as in S05-A".
Evidence / method: Annotation conditions; MHC restriction (external immunology knowledge).
Handling in this analysis: S05-A/B excluded; S05-I used with a caveat.

Finding: Both transferred-macrophage groups are labelled "Ly6C-CD206+ MPhi" (one should be Ly6C+CD206-).
Evidence / method: Header cells S07!B15 and S07!C15 are identical.
Impact on conclusions: The causal claim that a specific macrophage subset induces Tregs cannot be evaluated.
Handling in this analysis: Excluded from the MoA claims (shown as "unreadable").

Finding: Unchallenged, unvaccinated 20-month-old controls died within 14 days: 1/7, 0/7 and 3/7 (4/21 = 19%, exact 95% CI 5-42%). In S06-G, untreated survival (4/7) equals PSLN-344 survival (4/7).
Evidence / method: T1; deaths confirmed by frozen weights in S15-E/G.
Impact on conclusions: Background mortality of aged animals inflates apparent infection deaths; survival differences partly reflect frailty.
Handling in this analysis: Reported; replication must include unchallenged aged controls and cause-of-death (lung virus) confirmation.

Finding: Partial value overlap between two uptake experiments: AECII/PSLN-SRB values 17.7 and 17.5 appear in the same positions of both blocks; S08-C AECII-PSLN-344-SRB shares 4.92 and 4.13 with S01-B AECI/PSLN-SRB (a different cell type and particle).
Impact on conclusions: The Mn-particle uptake result (S08-C) is weaker evidence than it appears.

Finding: PSLN-344/R848 appears in S08-A but is not a documented preparation. Encapsulation efficiency of CDN-1807 by A260 is reported for PSLN-R848, which contains no CDN-1807.
Evidence / method: Annotation Materials section vs block group names.

Finding: Unlabelled numeric region: column A = 14 throughout, 6 zeros in column C and 7 in column D (the pattern of two all-surviving groups).
Evidence / method: Coverage check of every numeric cell (parse).
Impact on conclusions: Possibly an orphaned survival block with 100% survival, with unknown groups.

Finding: Missing metadata. Timepoint not stated for S07-B, S11-E, S13-H and S14-A. Challenge virus, dose and day not stated for S15-L/N (strain-generalisation studies). Challenge day not stated for S06-E(imprint). Adjuvant and age of the PTX group not stated (S02-C/E). S10-A is annotated as mean+/-SD but holds per-animal values. HAI zeros sit below the 1:10 lowest dilution (S03-C/G). S04-B Tfh:Tfr equals (100-Foxp3%)/Foxp3% exactly, so it is a derived, not independent, readout. The S09-A Ifnb1 row reuses S01-A animals (20/21 values), so it is not independent replication.
Impact on conclusions: Limits interpretation; no effect on direction of conclusions.
Handling in this analysis: HAI <10 imputed as 5; derived readouts not double-counted.

Finding: Design limitations: all animals female; single facility and protocol (PCL-26-0417); randomisation and blinding not documented; n=3-10 per group (n=7 gives about 55% power at the conservative effect, T12); no lung viral titres, mucosal IgA, histopathology, Mn quantification, DLS/TEM or stability data despite methods stating DLS/TEM were done; no licensed or benchmark comparator (e.g., MF59-like or high-dose vaccine).
Handling in this analysis: Reflected in the recommendation and next studies.
